data.title: Clearpoint
data.about:
Dive into a realm of unmatched elegance and tranquility at Clearpoint by Emaar at Rashid Yachts & Marina Dubai. Situated in a vibrant community that embodies sophistication, this exclusive development promises a home where every detail speaks of luxury.

Clearpoint at Rashid Yachts & Marina by Emaar Properties offers a refined selection of 1, 2, and 3 bedroom apartments and duplexes, meticulously designed to provide a haven of comfort and modernity. Emaar Clearpoint apartments stand as a testimony to architectural finesse, surrounded by lush green landscapes that offer a breath of fresh air amidst urban living.

Whether you're relishing the serene views from the Pocket Park or enjoying leisurely walks by the beautiful Canal Pool, Clearpoint ensures a harmonious blend of nature and contemporary conveniences. Moreover, with mesmerizing views of the Marina and the iconic Dubai Downtown skyline right from your home, you find yourself at the heart of everything beautiful.

location_tile.title: In the heart of it all!
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
A haven of luxury equipped with contemporary facilities, set amidst picturesque landscapes and just a stone's throw away from vibrant local attractions – Rashid Yachts & Marina presents the ideal locale for both relaxation and exploration, granting easy access to the best of what Dubai has to offer.

AREAS NEARBY:

  • 10 Mins to Shiekh Zayed Road
  • 15 Mins to Dubai International Airport
  • 20 Mins to Downtown Dubai
  • 20 Mins to the Dubai Mall/Burj Khalifa
  • 20 Mins to Dubai Creek Harbour
